governance.catalog: Coordinator checked the complete metrics catalog: count/list = 0. No approved definition matches. Native catalog writes blocked; draft proposals remain unapproved.

changes.reason: Per-chart seven-day product windows and ninety-day retention windows must coexist; inherited thirty-day dashboard override was removed.

insights.name: Active anonymous devices
insights.description: Distinct anonymous devices with a pageview during the selected period. These are not identified people. Browser/Electron renderer filter excludes public landing and legacy events without renderer metadata. Latest 7 days; opted-in coverage only.

insights.name: Sessions
insights.description: Distinct sessions with a pageview during the selected period. Uses the anonymous SDK session ID. Browser/Electron renderer filter excludes public landing and legacy events without renderer metadata. Latest 7 days; opted-in coverage only.

insights.name: Pageviews
insights.description: Normalized app pageviews during the selected period, including repeat visits. Query strings and chat IDs are excluded. Browser/Electron renderer filter excludes public landing and legacy events without renderer metadata. Latest 7 days; opted-in coverage only.

insights.name: Daily active anonymous devices
insights.description: Distinct anonymous devices with a pageview each day. Different browsers and cleared storage can count separately. Browser/Electron renderer filter excludes public landing and legacy events without renderer metadata. Latest 7 days; opted-in coverage only.

insights.name: Top app pages by active devices
insights.description: Distinct anonymous devices by canonical app page during the selected period. Each device can visit multiple pages. Browser/Electron renderer filter excludes public landing and legacy events without renderer metadata. Latest 7 days; opted-in coverage only.

insights.name: Weekly return visits
insights.description: First-visit app device cohorts returning in subsequent weeks, 90 days/8 intervals. Browser/Electron renderer filter excludes landing and legacy events without metadata. Anonymous devices are not people or installations.

insights.name: Core feature adoption — anonymous devices
insights.description: Distinct anonymous devices per core feature in the latest 7 days; counts are not additive or identified people/installations. Discovery scans are preserved. Workflow starts are accepted requests, not completed runs. Updated build must ship for complete capture.

insights.name: Chats, conversations and workflow requests
insights.description: Successful UI actions per day over 7 days, including conversation creation, continuations and question answers. Workflow starts are accepted requests, not completed runs. Updated conversation/question tracking awaits release; empty series do not imply no usage.

insights.name: Crew and workspace customization actions
insights.description: Successful UI configuration actions. Skill and routine saves include both creates and updates; saves are not unique configured entities.

insights.name: Onboarding preference updates by status
insights.description: Counts onboarding preference updates by saved status. Repeated updates can count several times; this is not an activation funnel.

insights.name: Crew and conversations — anonymous devices
insights.description: Distinct anonymous devices using conversation/question or crew features in the latest 7 days. Actions are successful UI requests; counts are not additive or verified people/installations. New conversation/question capture awaits release. Updated capture awaits release; empty series may reflect missing coverage.

insights.name: Browser and pipeline adoption — anonymous devices
insights.description: Counts distinct devices using browser open, manual takeover or approved pipeline follow-up saves. Private inputs and entity IDs are excluded. Updated capture awaits release; empty series may reflect missing coverage.

insights.name: Observed workspace readiness — anonymous devices
insights.description: Devices observed with each setup prerequisite met at least once in the interval. This is an observation, not a first-use conversion or current workspace count. Fictional demo cards do not satisfy job readiness. Updated capture awaits release; empty series may reflect missing coverage.

insights.name: Visit to explicit onboarding completion — 7-day funnel
insights.description: Devices viewing the app then explicitly completing onboarding within seven days. Existing workspaces default to deferred onboarding; this chart is not an installation activation rate. Updated capture awaits release; empty series may reflect missing coverage.

insights.name: Job entry and application import activity
insights.description: Successful manual job-card creation, external registration and applied import batches. Imports count batches, not individual applications; discovery-created leads are excluded.

insights.name: Job creation to exported packet — device funnel
insights.description: Proposed noncanonical proxy: anonymous device creates a job, starts workflow and exports within 30 days, allowing intervening events. Entrants from latest 7 days may still convert. Steps can involve different jobs; export is not submission or application conversion.

insights.name: Manual status moves by destination
insights.description: Count of manual UI status moves by destination state. Excludes agent/tracking transitions. Does not describe the current board population or hiring outcomes.

insights.name: Approval decisions by type and result
insights.description: Successful UI approval decisions by kind and approved boolean: true means approved; false means declined. Not a measure of execution success.

insights.name: Workflow return by week — anonymous devices
insights.description: Recurring cohorts of devices starting a workflow and starting another in subsequent calendar weeks. Standard native PostHog retention; anonymous IDs can reset or represent multiple users. Updated capture awaits release; empty series may reflect missing coverage.
